selection.cluster_rule: cluster with largest count of positive-duration single-GPU raw jobs
selection.eligible_rule: raw num_gpu==1 and duration>0, exact job_id match in authors' experiment trace, positive generated deadline slack
selection.sampling_method: contiguous block from submission-time-sorted eligible pool

deadline.source: matching ElasticFlow experiment trace deadline field
deadline.description: deadline is generated by the ElasticFlow authors based on their experiment rules; it is not a raw production field
deadline.carbon_class_rule: critical if slack_ratio<=q33, deferred if q33<ratio<=q67, flexible otherwise

workload_mapping.arrival_time: submission_time relative to first job in selected window

service_time.primary_rule: observed raw duration / locked FP32 resource speed factor
service_time.limitation: source hardware is not identified per job; treating raw duration as A6000-equivalent is a reconstruction proxy

qpeo_features.dependency_matrix: all zeros because the trace does not expose job dependency metadata
